existing_fixture_scope: Native-format/filter/Adam7 geometry matrix, APNG render/recovery, exact native sample bytes on 84 external/format files; primary lookup all 65,536 two-byte values and independent widths/padding; one-bit literal lengths 0..63; every legal match length/distance at eight bit offsets, fixed/dynamic trees and both padding values; prefix/suffix and exact/short limits; PNG/APNG/Adam7 and metadata in the full release suite.
performance_scope: One fewer observed realloc call for each of 21 format-corpus images, in both PNG decode and raw inflation, with identical logical peak/retained requested bytes and native samples on all 84 images. The longer three-case stored subset supports a modest raw benefit; broader photo/format PNG throughput is inconclusive. Longer checks do not repeat the short-run gray8 PNG and RGB16 raw outliers. No broad speedup or decoder parity is claimed.
